memo: New part on the 0.440 base, CPU kernel (GPU quota spent until 10-17). Base: canqiang/casmi26-e006-window-40-ice-fallback-true v1 (public LB 0.440, Apache-2.0), base cells unchanged except the CPU edits (as e3fg05c-1 = 0.432). Ours, on top of e3fg05c-1 (fragment re-rank where ICEBERG and GLACIER are both blind): our dn1 formula-constrained de novo generator (SMILES decoder trained by us, ours_denovo.py) decodes under the top 2 formulas of engine pass 1, keeps the top 20 by our fp2 log-likelihood and injects them through the pc_join route so the base ranker, ICEBERG / GLACIER and fusion score them in pass 2 (60 min cap). First test of de novo on the E006 base (on the 0.420 base it was -0.008). Hypothesis: LB > 0.432; if not, de novo stays off the 10-17 GPU runs.
